Seven.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% trims his value as a second/third anti-heal buyer; single-source Healbane and his farm engine are untouched.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Static Charge T3 stun 0.9->1.1s; Spirit Lifesteal +2/+2% and Healbane's multi-source anti-heal stacking are both core, and Haunt bounty/growth +10% is pure profit for the fastest one-cycle clearer — the new comeback levers also drop the 'farm a lead only' cap on a behind Seven.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): nine behavior-varied Haunt types (grouped/chasing) make the fastest camp clear the biggest income lever in the game; he has no crate or Barrel Mimic route and does not need one.

Vindicta.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Celeste's Dazzling Trick T3 silence, Radiant Daggers cast range 30->25m and Shining Wonder slow/cooldown nerfs soften one of her listed losing matchups (46%); her gun core and flyer tax are unchanged.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, indirect): High-Velocity Rounds velocity 60->45% removes the max-range guarantee her gun core buys first and air drag 0.35->0.5 taxes every airborne exit; the roofs and hub-fight value are unchanged, the range is not.
City Never Sleeps (09-29, indirect): new roofs/high ground and telegraphed Plaza/Bell Tower hub fights favor her max-range poke; flyer tax unchanged.

Lady Geist.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% relieves the anti-heal stacking that is her listed counter, and Celeste loses silence duration/cast range/ult slow; the Radiant Regeneration trim still caps her.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Essence Bomb 1.22->1.35 spirit scaling only pays the Soul-Exchange line; Radiant Regeneration becomes in-combat-only at 65->40/1.7->1.4/0.35->0.25 on a 98%-buy slot, and Decay's incoming-heal penalty deepens -50->-55% on a core slot she fights out of.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps plus Barrel Mimic fights make farm a sustain check her regen stack passes, and container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls add free frontline stats; the same dive heroes still eat her.

Abrams.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% softens the anti-heal stacking that taxes Siphon Life, and Celeste's silence/ult slow nerfs reduce the spirit burst that out-ranges his engage.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): base gun damage +5% and Siphon Life T3 +18->+22 DPS are small fight-length gains, but the Shoulder Charge fix removes his free hold on enemies who never hit a wall; Hunter's Aura is now LOS-gated, so Battle Vest/Bullet Lifesteal (which never turn off) compete for the same slot.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Barrel Mimics convert breakable-chaining into a sustain check his heavy-melee + Siphon core passes, making the uncontestable crate route safer than it is for squishy gun clearers.

Wraith.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Celeste's Dazzling Trick T3 silence, Radiant Daggers cast range and Shining Wonder slow/cooldown nerfs soften her worst listed matchup (42%); her fire-rate gun core is untouched.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Card Trick heal 60->45 and Project Mind 46->50s with a slower 0.75->1s initial cast trim the only sustain and the repositioning her survival plan runs on; her fire-rate gun core (Monster Rounds/Quicksilver Reload/Rapid Rounds/Swift Striker/Ricochet) is untouched.
09-16: Card Trick heal 75->60, heal scaling 0.75->0.5, resist shred -8->-7% (T3 -5->-4%), T3 slow +20->+15%; Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow gutted and Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto spirit damage — on-hit-spirit core weakened, lean pure gun.

Kelvin.why: Support/healer whose dome and heal throughput get real relief from the Healbane 4-stack cap cut (82.2->72%) while his own single-source Healbane loses nothing; his Extra Regen/Healing Booster core is untouched, but cheap Healing Snacks and mobile dive still cap him.
Kelvin.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% is a direct reprieve for dome/heal throughput; his own Healbane is single-source, so he loses nothing on the giving side.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps and Barrel Mimic fights raise dome/sustain value while cheap Healing Snacks cap the between-fight healing he used to sell; his dome is worth most at the announced hub contests, not in lane.
10-14: Radiant Regeneration spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 trims rival sustain (Baba, Lady Geist, Shiv, Celeste) while his Extra Regen/Healing Booster core is untouched - small relative gain.

Haze.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Celeste's Dazzling Trick T3 silence, Radiant Daggers cast range 30->25m and Shining Wonder slow/cooldown nerfs soften her worst listed matchup (42%); her gun core and anti-gun defences are unchanged.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Smoke Bomb T3 no longer dispels undispellable debuffs (e.g. Specter Crash), and Return Fire now returns Fixation damage plus shows its 10% bullet resist on the tooltip, handing frontline tanks the anti-Haze slot they were already buying; Bullet Resilience 30->35% adds a second cheap answer.
09-16 (indirect): Plated Armor's on-hit fix now blanks Tesla Bullets spirit damage, weakening her Ricochet/Tesla late pivot.

Holliday.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Mo & Krill's Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP/kill 40->50 make a listed losing matchup tougher; her pick targets are unchanged.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): behavior-varied camps and Barrel Mimics leave farmers stationary at predictable spots — more lasso targets — and the Bell Tower payout is a scheduled map-wide announcement she can pre-place bounce pads around.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): new districts and Steam-Vent invisibility expand her roam routes and Bell Tower hub fights reward Spirit Lasso picks; point-blank lockdown still punishes her commit.

Bebop.why: Single-target hook initiator whose one job is worth less every patch; the Healbane 4-stack cap cut (82.2->72%) makes the sustain comps that already erase his hook combo (Kelvin 42%) harder to burst, and he got nothing back.
Bebop.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% helps the sustain archetype that erases his hook combo (Kelvin, his worst matchup at 42%); Celeste's nerfs remove one losing matchup as a small offset.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Steam Vents give every hooked target a free disengage he cannot chase, and a spread corridor farm offers a single-target hook nothing to punish.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): a single-target hook cannot punish Haunt/crate routing, contested Soul Bags only partly extend his fights, and the roamer slot has tilted to Paradox.

Calico.why: Melee-spirit assassin whose burst window is real but whose losing matchups got tougher: the softer Healbane cap rewards the stacked-HP frontlines she cannot burst (Victor, Abrams), and her snowball still has less margin after the Steam Vent rework.
Calico.notes:
Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (indirect): Healbane's 4-stack anti-heal cap 82.2->72% rewards the sustain frontlines she cannot burst (Victor 45%, Abrams 46%), her listed losing matchups; she got no direct compensation.
Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (10-30, direct): Leaping Slash T3 +60->+90 damage and Ava T3 6->8s sharpen her melee-spirit burst and second pick; the Steam Vent rework (stamina regen instead of invisibility) trims one roam route, and the raised non-hero comeback gold + tick souls punish a snowball that stalls.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): districts and vent invisibility extend her roam; cat form still can't heavy-melee Tough Crates, and the frontline meta gives her more unburstable bodies.
